# Office confirmations for redaction (unanswered)

The files here are written by the redaction test suite (`tests/OneDocument.Redaction.Tests`, generated by our own code, no oracle output) from generated packages that plant a secret string in every place `docs/redaction.md` lists. Each is the redacted result.

Request for the Office run (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, version recorded by the run):

1. Open each file in the matching application. Record: opens without a repair prompt (yes/no, and the prompt text), and whether each file opens in Protected View without complaint.
2. For `redacted-everywhere.*`: record the visible text of the first page/sheet/slide and whether the black-box marks appear where the secret was; for the workbook, whether the table, the defined names and the sheet named with the identifier mark open and calculate; for the presentation, whether the chart, table and picture show.
3. For `redacted-paragraph-region.docx`, `redacted-cell-region.xlsx`, `redacted-slide-and-shape.pptx`: record that the removed content is gone and that the neighbouring content is unchanged; for the workbook, whether the shared-formula and pivot warnings need a repair.
4. In Excel, for `redacted-everywhere.xlsx`: record whether `Table...[Header...]` structured references recalculate to `#REF!` (documented in the gaps).

## Added by the completeness review (unanswered)

Generated by `tests/OneDocument.Redaction.Tests/Attacks.cs`; each is the redacted output of one hostile input. For each: opens in Word/Excel without a repair prompt (yes/no, prompt text)? Text unchanged apart from the redaction?

- `review-base64-custom-xml.docx`: custom XML parts whose base64 payloads were rewritten in place.
- `review-png-text-chunk.docx`: a picture whose text chunk was dropped.
- `review-fragmented-object.docx`: an embedded compound-file object overwritten across sectors.
- `review-zip-comments.docx`: zip comments blanked.
- `review-escaped-strings.xlsx`: shared string with `_xHHHH_` escapes redacted and written back escaped.
